statement: Implement the five Scenario A deep-stack throughput and latency optimizations: (1) propagate bound params into SELECT ... FOR UPDATE reservation checks, merge WHERE equality-bound PK columns with projected row columns in resolveCanonicalPkTuples, and preserve params/orderBy/limit in queryMatchingPkRows; (2) skip redundant retainParticipantSet mutations when the participant set is unchanged and skip transient pre-RPC participant status writes (PREPARING, COMMITTING, ROLLING_BACK) in persistDistributedTransactionParticipantRow; (3) batch concurrently queued proposals per Ready cycle in RaftRsRuntimeOwner and expose batching telemetry in RaftRsDurableStore; (4) extract canonical primary-key row identities for INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE in checkAndRecordSessionRowKey and allow row-key-disjoint sessions to PREPARE and COMMIT across intermediate disjoint commits on the same partition; and (5) validate disjoint-row staged writes in O(1) without O(N^2) prefix replay when generation and schema_version are unchanged.

constraints.statement: Participant-set CAS writes still execute whenever the participant set changes or freezes, and PREPARED participant rows with prepared_digest, prepare_index, and prepare_term are durably persisted before recording a COMMIT decision.
Batched proposals in RaftRsRuntimeOwner are persisted in a single Ready cycle with synchronous durability before outbound messages are sent or advance_ready is invoked.

Concurrent sessions touching overlapping row keys are deterministically refused on staging or PREPARE with 40001 conflict semantics, and same-row staged writes and session SELECTs still replay prior session operations.
